messages:
Elaine (Design): dropping the compact rules list mock here — trying a smaller reorder handle and condensed copy. screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/compact-reorder.png
Taylor (Eng): looks cleaner. concern: touch target might get too small on mobile. we should keep at least 44px hit area.
Samir (PM): can we make the validation copy for duplicate priorities less technical? current: "Duplicate priority detected" feels terse. suggestion: "Two rules share the same priority — pick a different order so routing is deterministic."
Morgan (Accessibility): big a11y flag: VoiceOver reads the little dotted handle as just "button". need descriptive aria-labels. also keyboard users can't grab via space/enter.
Jisoo (Design Ops): noted — i trimmed the handle visually but we could keep an invisible padding for hit area. also thinking of showing a drag affordance on hover/focus only to reduce clutter.
Taylor (Eng): implementation notes: we can keep visual size small but extend touch area via padding on the container. for VO: add aria-label to the handle like: `aria-label="Move rule: <rule name>"` and `tabindex=0` + keydown handler for space/enter to toggle a grabbed state.
Morgan (Accessibility): exact wording: `aria-label="Reorder rule: {{ruleTitle}}"` — and when grabbed, set `aria-grabbed="true"` and announce "Grabbed. Use arrow keys to move. Press space to drop.". also add `role="button"` to keep it discoverable.
Elaine (Design): love the microcopy suggestion for the announcement. can we shorten the visual hint text though? in compact mode the rule title is truncated so "{{ruleTitle}}" might be unreadable — maybe include a tooltip on focus that shows the full title.
Samir (PM): small copy tweak for validation states: states we currently have: "priority conflict", "missing target". propose making them active-helpful: "Conflict: two rules share priority — reorder or change numbers" and "No destination: add a target or rule will be skipped". Thoughts?
Jisoo (Design Ops): Agree. Also the preview panel label: current "Simulate traffic" gets mis-clicked. propose: "Preview with sample requests" (more explicit).
Taylor (Eng): quick CSS snippet for padded hit area:
````
.rule-handle { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.rule-handle::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -12px; right: -12px; top: -12px; bottom: -12px; }
````
This keeps visuals small but increases the tap/click zone.
Morgan (Accessibility): +1 to tooltip on focus and the aria-grabbed flow. also check contrast for the focus ring in compact list — current 1.9:1 is failing. need >=3:1 for thin outlines.
Elaine (Design): noted — i'll update mocks with a thicker focus ring and tooltip on focus. also trying two label variants for preview button to run a quick hallway test.
Samir (PM): action items: Taylor — add aria-label/grabbed keyboard handlers in the reorder PR. Elaine — update mocks (tooltip + focus ring + preview copy variants). Morgan — quick a11y review after PR. Jisoo — update copy strings in i18n keys.
Taylor (Eng): will do. FYI deploy-bot: created branch `reorder/a11y-handle` (CI queued).
deploy-bot: CI passed for reorder/a11y-handle — build 52342.
Jisoo (Design Ops): thanks — if ux tests go well i can push the copy changes to staging for Localization to review.
Morgan (Accessibility): one more thing: when simulation runs, the preview should expose a short status live region: "Preview: running (12 requests)" and then "Preview complete: 12 requests simulated" — so screen readers get live updates.
Elaine (Design): great catch. adding live region to the preview panel in the mock.
Taylor (Eng): ok closing loop — i'll include aria-grabbed, keyboard, and focus updates in the PR and ping the thread when ready for a11y sign-off.
Samir (PM): thanks team. quick emoji check: react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the copy tweaks, :eyes: if you want to review the PR.
Elaine (Design): :thumbsup:
Morgan (Accessibility): :eyes:
Jisoo (Design Ops): :thumbsup:
